phase: Corporate Investment — Financing-Rate Source Continuity Screening
purpose: Compare source continuity only for two exact ECB MIR Romania NFC RON new-business lending-rate families before any investment-model fitting. The screening may determine whether the narrower up-to-one-year fixation family is measurement-eligible when the broad total-fixation family is too sparse for a quarterly time-series design. It does not compare predictive performance or estimate any investment equation.

candidates.semantic_scope: total initial-rate fixation; total amount; S11; RON; new business
variable/up-to-one-year initial-rate fixation; total amount; S11; RON; new business

eligibility_rule.rule: The up-to-one-year family is measurement-eligible for a separately amended contract only if its complete-quarter coverage is at least 0.90 and exceeds the broad total-fixation family's complete-quarter coverage by at least 0.20. Even then, the semantic narrowing must be recorded before panel reconstruction.
